name: 🌷 My Flower Shop
desc:
Start with a small flower shop and grow it into a flourishing florist. Plant, grow, and harvest beautiful flowers, craft bouquets and floral arrangements, and welcome customers as you expand your garden and shop.

🌸 Plant, grow, and harvest a wide variety of beautiful flowers!
💐 Craft bouquets and other floral arrangements!
🛍️ Sell flowers and handcrafted creations to customers!
🌱 Your flowers will grow offline!
💼 Hire staffs and upgrade your shop as you level up!
🏡 Decorate your flower shop and garden to create the coziest atmosphere!
🔥 Daily streaks! Come back every day for rewards!

🔔 Don't forget to hit the FOLLOW button to be notified when new updates are available! Or follow us on the social media platforms listed below!

✨ Join our group for 2X DAILY REWARDS!

👍💬 More content is coming soon! Like the game to support our development!
